definitions.accuracy: Applicable SQLLogicTest records passed / all applicable records; unsupported and errors remain nonpasses.
definitions.speed: Paired suite wall-time percentage change versus tested public main on the same host and configuration. Negative change means less time (faster).

records.speed_absence: No accepted paired suite wall-time comparison against tested public main. The retained historical baseline is not that main baseline.

speed.configuration: ordinary release; no PGO; Rust 1.90.0; debug=0, strip=none
speed.limits: Sequential role phases pair matching rotations; descriptive intervals do not eliminate temporal drift. Quietness was sampled; a connection interruption had unknown timing impact. Query 16 was slower and remains included. Timed samples retain row counts, not every output payload. Engine-accounted resources are not hard process caps. No Alpha 3 or 0.95 goal qualification.
